page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.xlarge is a compute-optimized instance belonging to the High Clock Speed family. It is driven by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6462C processor clocked at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz. The instance provisions 4 dedicated virtual CPUs alongside 8.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor architecture without attached hardware graphics accelerators.

Storage and networking capabilities rely entirely on remote cloud resources, as the instance features no bundled local storage disks. Inbound and outbound network traffic is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. The absence of integrated local storage means persistence and data throughput are constrained to external block storage volumes, which must be provisioned independently.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU allocation targets compute-intensive workloads that prioritize processor speed and dedicated execution threads over vast memory capacity. This configuration is structurally appropriate for front-end batch processing, continuous integration and build pipelines, compute-bound microservices, and web servers that do not require high in-memory caching footprints.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server from the High Clock Speed instance family, built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor running at 3.3 GHz, it features 4 dedicated virtual CPUs and 8.0 GB of memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The server provides a baseline network throughput of 4 Gbps and contains no bundled local storage volumes or GPU acceleration, requiring network-attached storage for disk operations. Because resource allocation prioritizes clock speed and dedicated processor execution rather than memory capacity, the instance is positioned for compute-bound processing tasks, web serving, CI/CD application builds, and lightweight batch workflows where memory consumption remains moderate.
